title: Radical Numerics, which is developing AI models that learn directly from biological data, raised a $50M seed led by Emergence Capital (Natalie Breymeyer/Axios)
summary: Natalie Breymeyer / Axios: Radical Numerics, which is developing AI models that learn directly from biological data, raised a $50M seed led by Emergence Capital — Radical Numerics, an AI research lab for biological data, raised a $50 million seed round, CEO Eric Nguyen tells Axios.
